comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Another new battle-ship "Satisfaction", based on Henry Morgan's sailing ship. Buildable in London or Jamaica with Large 2-decked Hull. Stats, level requirements, and skill set already updated in this ivyro.

Comes from Order of the Prince Chapter 3 Honor in 23th January 2019.

comments.author: Wsp
comments.body: This is NOT buildable in Jamaica, only London. No idea where PP got their info. Jamaica doesn't even have a SY lol. It will cost 60m initially to build as Iron and to change -20% another 12m. Beautiful looking ship I must say. Size is slightly smaller than a Razee Frigate.
